lead.title: Mistral releases open weights for Mistral Large 4, a trillion-parameter MoE built for cyber defense
lead.summary: Mistral AI published the full weights of Mistral Large 4 (Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B), a roughly 1T-parameter Mixture-of-Experts with about 52B active parameters, 1M-token context and multimodal input, trained in its own data centers. It tops open models on Cognition's FrontierCode agentic-coding benchmark and was independently evaluated on cyberdefense tasks by CrowdStrike, Cloudflare, Rubrik and Zscaler. Commercial use and self-hosting are allowed under a modified MIT-style license; paid MaaS resale needs a separate license.

top_stories.title: Anthropic acquires one-person biotech startup Mithril Medicine
top_stories.summary: Anthropic bought Mithril Medicine, founded by Cody Tranbarger, which uses AI to design bispecific antibodies for rare muscular dystrophies. The deal extends frontier labs deeper into AI-driven drug development.

top_stories.title: Wabi, the AI agent that builds mini apps, hits $1.25B valuation
top_stories.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's Wabi raised a $55M round led by IVP, with a16z, Forerunner, the Amazon Alexa Fund and angels including Tobi Lütke and Marc Benioff.

top_stories.title: Together AI launches US-only serverless inference endpoints
top_stories.summary: Geo-specific endpoints serve seven leading open models processed entirely in the U.S. via us-api.together.ai, at about 1.25x standard rates, targeting data-residency and compliance requirements.

top_stories.title: Deepgram acquires Daily, maker of the open-source Pipecat framework
top_stories.summary: The voice AI company is buying the Pipecat orchestration framework's maker to strengthen its voice infrastructure stack. Terms were not disclosed.

items.title: There Is No Free Lunch in RLVR: every pass@1 gain has a pass@k price
items.summary: A theorem shows RLVR's pass@1 gains come at an exact pass@k cost: the base model overtakes the RL-trained one at large sampling budgets, and the reversal is a computable price, not undertraining noise.

items.title: Turing LLM post-training: calibrated distillation and efficient dynamic-MoE execution
items.summary: C-MOPD distills multiple teachers into a routed MoE, matching each teacher on its local Top-K support with per-teacher loss normalization, plus an efficient execution path for merging specialists.

items.title: Sandman: operating sandboxes for agentic RL on shared Kubernetes
items.summary: Amazon describes a production service where a single training job bursts thousands of task environments on a shared cluster, with a documented design for multi-tenant agentic RL workloads.

items.title: A unified Hessian-guided framework for post-training quantization
items.summary: Jointly optimizing quantization ranges, linear transformations and weight rounding in one objective improves low-bit LLM accuracy over per-component approaches.

items.title: Only accepted tokens count: an energy accounting of speculative decoding
items.summary: Frames speculative decoding as energy per accepted token under latency targets, showing how drafter-proposed tokens trade facility power against per-user latency.

items.title: Heterogeneous co-evolution trains tool-efficient search agents with zero labels
items.summary: Co-evolving the training question distribution with the agent optimizes answer quality and tool-call efficiency using outcome-only reinforcement signals.

items.title: How I Aligned Your Model: scaling multilingual safety training with templates
items.summary: A template-based augmentation pipeline generates region-localized harmful-topic coverage to fix the English-centric skew of safety training data.

items.title: Nvidia eyes retired German nuclear plant sites for AI data centers
items.summary: Nvidia is exploring converting decommissioned nuclear power plant sites in Germany into large AI data center campuses to secure grid capacity — while drawing the line at reactivating the reactors.

items.title: Lingyi Zhizao shows humanoid robotics momentum in Q3 earnings
items.summary: The Chinese precision-manufacturing supplier's results point to rapid progress in humanoid robots and AI-driven manufacturing.

items.title: GoodAI founder details robotics R&D progress in weekly dev diary
items.summary: Marek Rosa's October 29 diary covers ongoing embodied-AI and robotics research challenges at his labs.

items.title: Permaura gives AI agents permissions instead of API keys
items.summary: The open-source gateway holds apps' API keys and enforces per-action permission rules, so agents like Claude Code and Cursor never see credentials; sensitive actions need approvals signed on your phone or watch.

items.title: Meta quietly launches Style Sketch, an AI fashion app
items.summary: The app builds a virtual closet from Instagram photos and suggests outfits with virtual try-on; it is available only in Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand.

items.title: Charter: field-level access control for AI agents in Python
items.summary: R28's Pydantic-based library mirrors every agent tool to an API field with your rules on top, validating each call and generating an egress map from the code.

items.title: Granola adds dictation to its meeting notetaker
items.summary: Granola's AI dictation works across all Mac apps via the Fn key, competing directly with Wispr Flow as voice AI startups converge into multi-feature apps.

items.title: Quantum Italia invests €200k in post-quantum crypto spin-off Promethence
items.summary: The Scientifica-backed vehicle invested in the Politecnico di Milano spin-off developing hardware and software post-quantum cryptography for data centers and critical infrastructure.

items.title: CDP's FoodSeed accelerator picks 7 foodtech startups with €250k each
items.summary: Out of 225 applications, five Italian and two US-based startups each receive an initial €250k; the batch includes AI-designed antioxidants and greenhouse robots for plant health.
